integrity: Analytical proof and explicit independent finite computational consistency checks; computations do not certify universal conclusions or priority.
scientific_limitations: Unbiased absorbed one-dimensional lattice; independently resampled, bounded and strictly positive periodic rates. Finite-disorder crossing existence, not uniqueness. Weak-disorder unique sign transition is only a second-order claim. Mean hitting time remains infinite.
title: A one-step obstruction and a sharp late-time penalty for fluctuating lattice jump rates
